_comment: USABILITY.md section 16: human actions per task. official = official 3D Slicer 5.13; wave1 = measured on the wave 1 build before QW-A/QW-B (kept for the record); afterQW = the estimate for the post-QW build (the gate baseline is compared with it, +-15%); target_wN = the limit after wave N. null = not applicable. Metrics of a task are listed as <task>.<metric>; the key without a dot is the headline of the task.
